regions.merged_text: Hope this finds you all well. Was a little disapointed the other night. I hoped to get in touch with you all. Well, when I heard Grandma's voice I thought that would suffice and I told the operator "OK." I want to thank Grace too and George - and all the others for their favors not always acknowledged. I hope you all have a Joyful Christmas in the peace of the Lord. Also I ask you all to continue a little prayer for this poor sinner once in a while.
